profile.ja: ふうま八将が一角・二車家を支える幹部。黒騎家は古来より勇猛果敢な剛の者を輩出してきた名家であるが、その中にあって雫は異質な存在。小さく華奢な体躯ながら戦闘の天才で、邪眼“盲目の赤蛇眼”を持ち、発動すると彼の影から“闇の雫”が湧いて出て、重力に逆らうかのように上方へ零れ出る。この“闇の雫”には体の一部あるいは全部を隠す事もでき、雫は天性の身体能力と戦闘センスでこれを自在に操って戦う。例えば肉体の一部を隠して敵の刀を回避し、同時に敵の背後に飛ばした闇の雫から右腕を出現させ攻撃を行う、といった風に。また、彼が武器として持つエネルギーブレードの鉤爪は出力によって自在に伸縮し、エネルギー切れの時には鉤爪に仕込まれた本物のブレードが出る仕組みになっている。対魔忍衣装は高度にテクノロジー化されており、脚部装甲は鉤爪の重量や反動を軽減させるユニットとなっていて、彼の素早い動きをサポートしている。
profile.en: He is a high-ranking officer supporting the Kuroki family, one of the two houses of the Fuuma Eight Generals. The Kuroki family has long been known for producing bold and daring warriors, but Shizuku is an unusual presence among them. Despite his small and slender physique, he is a genius in combat, possessing the evil eye known as the "Blind Red Snake Eye." When activated, a dark liquid called "Dark Droplets" emerges from his shadow, flowing upwards as if defying gravity. This "Dark Droplets" can also be used to hide parts or all of his body, and Shizuku can manipulate it freely with his natural physical abilities and combat sense to fight. For example, he can hide part of his body to avoid an enemy's sword and simultaneously attack from behind with his right arm emerging from the "Dark Droplets" thrown at the enemy's back. Additionally, the energy blade he wields has claws that can extend and retract freely depending on the output, and when the energy runs out, real blades embedded in the claws are deployed. The Taimanin costume is highly technologically advanced, with leg armor units that reduce the weight and recoil of the claws, supporting his quick movements.

text.ja: えーっと確か、次の任務はここで……って、お前はふうま宗家の！？　ウソだろ。僕、帰る！　帰るからな！
text.en: Hmm, I think the next mission is... wait, you're from the main Fuuma house!? No way. I'm outta here! I'm going home!

text.ja: ふあぁーあ、任務があるならあるで、さっさと連れてってよ。なんでこんな辛気臭い場所でお前と顔付き合わせてなきゃいけないんだよー
text.en: Ugh, if there's a mission, just take me already. Why do I have to meet up with you in a place like this? It's so boring.

text.ja: えっ、アイスあるの？　べ、別に欲しくなんてないよ。けど、溶けちゃうのはもったいないよね。仕方ないから食べてあげるよ！
text.en: Huh, you have ice cream? I-I don't really want any or anything. But it'd be a waste if it melts, so I'll eat it, I guess.

text.ja: 骸佐様、何考えてるんだろ。僕の事、いらなくなっちゃったのかな。……っ！？　なっ、何聞いてるんだよ！　あっちいけ！
text.en: Nisha Gaiza, what's he thinking? Has he decided I'm useless or something? ...Huh? What are you listening to? Shoo!

text.ja: あー、はいはい。お説教はごめんだよ。ちゃんと結果は出してるでしょ？　もう、うるさいなー。後は闇の僕とでも話してなよ
text.en: Yeah, yeah, spare me the lecture. I'm getting the results, aren't I? You're so annoying. Just go talk to my dark self or something.

text.ja: 協力するからには勝手な事をしてはなりませんよ………なんて、尚兄め。そう言われてなかったら、今頃お前の首はなかったのになぁ……
text.en: If you're going to cooperate, you can't just do whatever you want... that's what my brother would say. If he hadn't said that, you'd be dead by now...

text.ja: なあ、あの珪遁のおじさんに言っといてよ。僕に会うたび師匠面して稽古つけようとするなって。お前の言う事なら聞くんだろ？
text.en: Hey, tell that old man from the Kaito clan that every time we meet, he doesn't have to act like a master and try to train me. He'll listen to you, right?
